product_metadata.title: Goodpick Tall Wicker Laundry Basket with handles, Farmhouse Laundry Hamper for Bedroom, Living Room, Bathroom, Narrow Laundry hamper for Dirty Clothes, Blankets, Towels, 12.59 x 20.86 inches
features: Stylish Storage Solution. This jute laundry basket with an exclusive design is perfect for the farmhouse style home. Combining functionality and style, it can organize clutter while bringing style to any space such as laundry, living room, family room, bedroom, bathroom and more

Multi-purpose. This clothes hamper measures 12.59 x 12.59 x 20.86 inches, which is large enough to store your daily stuff but takes up little space. It provides an attractive storage solution for clothes, toys, stuffed animals, towels, blankets, pillows, sheets, comforters, yoga mats. Help you hide clutter and keep your home tidy
Handle Design. This laundry basket organizer is designed with two large easy-to-grab handles for maximum portability, which allows you to move the basket around your home with ease

Sturdy & Durable. This woven laundry hamper is made of jute rope, which is sturdy and designed for long-lasting use. Different from a wicker or rattan basket, this basket will not scratch your hands, clothes, floors

Note. This bathroom hamper is folded for shipping. It will turn back to its elegant shape quickly by filling it with towels or blankets, and ironing is a great idea to regain the creases. Also, you can fold it into a flat shape for easy storage when not in use
